findings.issue: Unknown resources render a custom NotFound component inline, so all not-found pages (including the catch-all at app/app/[...slug]/page.jsx) respond with HTTP 200; the spec explicitly encouraged 404.
findings.suggestion: Call notFound() from 'next/navigation' and render the markup in an app/not-found.jsx boundary; the catch-all route can then be deleted.

findings.issue: Hidden module-global promiseCache (plus four module-level promise singletons and a shared mutable byId Map mutated at line 117) with no TTL/eviction; every page depends on it and nothing outside lib/api.js knows it exists.
findings.suggestion: Use React's cache() for per-request dedup and keep any intentional cross-request caching in one explicit, documented structure with bounded entries.

findings.issue: Promise.all over 48 per-card API fetches with no error boundary anywhere: a single failed request (or one rejection in cards.js' fan-out) rejects the whole page with no error.jsx to soften it.
findings.suggestion: Add app/error.jsx and tolerate individual fetch failures (fall back to placeholder sprite / null types) instead of failing the page.

findings.issue: Builds URLs from window.location.search and keeps debounced local search state that never re-syncs with the q prop, so back/forward navigation leaves the input out of sync with the URL; MovesSection.jsx:31 already shows the idiomatic useSearchParams pattern.
findings.suggestion: Derive params from useSearchParams() and sync search state when the q prop changes (or lift filter state into one place).

findings.issue: Sprite fallback fabricates /media/sprites/pokemon/<id>.png when front_default is null — exactly the case the API says to expect — producing a broken image rather than SPRITE_PLACEHOLDER; the same logic is duplicated at app/app/page.jsx:84-85.
findings.suggestion: Extract one helper (e.g. in lib/cards.js) that returns front_default ?? SPRITE_PLACEHOLDER and use it everywhere.

findings.issue: EvolutionNode/EvolutionList are a needless mutual pair of wrapper components adding indirection for no reuse.
`single(value)` is duplicated verbatim in app/app/pokemon/[name]/page.jsx:29, and the id-extraction regex at app/app/abilities/[name]/page.jsx:24 reimplements lib/format.js idFromUrl.
findings.suggestion: Move both into lib/format.js and import them.

findings.issue: Row keys embed the array index, which can cause subtle reconciliation issues if rows reorder under sorting.
findings.suggestion: Key by moveName plus level (guaranteed unique within a method table).

findings.issue: Stat-bar scale denominator 180 is a magic constant buried in JSX.
findings.suggestion: Hoist to a named constant near STAT_LABELS in lib/format.js with a one-line comment on why 180.

findings.issue: Plain bypasses next/image; defensible given the dynamic remote media host, but the choice is undocumented (one of only 2 comments in the codebase explains anything).
findings.suggestion: Either configure images.remotePatterns and use next/image, or leave a comment explaining why was chosen.

summary: A well-structured, current-convention App Router app: async params/searchParams handled correctly on Next 16, clean server/client boundaries, and a genuinely good shared card-building abstraction. The merge blockers are localized: hand-rolled 404 handling that costs the spec-encouraged HTTP 404 status, a hidden global promise cache in lib/api.js, no error boundary over wide fetch fan-out, and a small handful of duplicated helpers and fabricated sprite URLs. I'd request one round of changes and then merge.
